30.brief: Madness Burn still leads Pauper's big events at 13%, but it dropped 6.8 pts. Mono-Green Elves gained most, up 5.8 pts to 6.8%, while Mono-Blue Terror fell 8.4 pts. Baleful Strix jumped into 16% of decks.

Madness Burn leads Pauper at 14%, down 4.3 pts, ahead of Affinity at 10%. Dimir Control gained most, driving Baleful Strix into 18% of decks, while Mono-Blue Terror fell 5.7 pts. Vandalblast is now in 16% of sideboards.

bans.brief: Ponza gained most after Seeker of Skybreak's ban, rising from 2.3% to 5.6%. Mono-Blue Terror also grew, from 13% to 16%. The shares haven't settled yet.
Bonder's Ornament found homes fast: it's in 93% of Ponza lists and 90% of Tron lists since May 18. Ephemerate Flicker gained most, rising from 1.7% to 5.4%. The shares haven't settled yet.
